questions.question: When should you use "Yours faithfully" versus "Yours sincerely"?

points.text: "Yours faithfully" with Dear Sir/Madam; "Yours sincerely" when using a specific name (Dear Mr Smith).

questions.question: What is the correct order for a formal letter's components?

points.text: Sender's address, date, recipient's address, salutation, content, sign-off, signature.

questions.question: Write the opening of a letter to your local council about litter in your area.

points.text: Your opening should include: sender's address, date, council's address, "Dear Sir/Madam", and a clear statement of purpose.

questions.question: Why should you avoid contractions in formal letters?

points.text: Contractions are too informal for formal writing. Writing "do not" instead of "don't" maintains a professional, respectful tone.
